e.title: insurance-quantile
e.summary: 尾部风险分位数/expectile 回归（burning-cost，PyPI 0.5.0）：TVaR/大额损失加载/ILF 曲线/EQRN 极端分位网络
e.summary_en: Actuarial tail risk quantile/expectile regression (burning-cost, PyPI 0.5.0): TVaR, large loss loading, ILF curves, EQRN extreme quantile networks
e.summary_hk: 尾部風險分位數/expectile 迴歸（burning-cost，PyPI 0.5.0）：TVaR/大額損失加載/ILF 曲線/EQRN 極端分位網絡
e.body: insurance-quantile（burning-cost，PyPI v0.5.0）做保险定价的尾部风险分位数/expectile 回归：TVaR 相关风险量、大额损失加载、ILF（增额损失因子）曲线、EQRN 极端分位神经网络（Pasche & Engelke）——英国个人险定价场景。对 RIAA：尾部定价的专门工具——与 [[insurance-severity]]（严重度建模）配套：severity 管分布、quantile 管尾部回归；ILF 曲线是再保险与超额定价的核心（[[reinsurance]] 视角）；EQRN 是极值分位回归的前沿（[[insurance-conformal]] 预测区间之外的另一尾部分支）；burning-cost 家族第 23 个成员。
e.body_en: insurance-quantile (burning-cost, PyPI v0.5.0) does actuarial tail risk quantile/expectile regression for insurance pricing: TVaR-related risk measures, large loss loading, ILF (increased limit factor) curves, EQRN extreme quantile neural networks (Pasche & Engelke) — UK personal lines pricing. For RIAA: the dedicated tool for tail pricing — pairs with [[insurance-severity]] (severity modelling): severity handles distributions, quantile handles tail regression; ILF curves are core to reinsurance and excess pricing ([[reinsurance]] view); EQRN is the frontier of extreme quantile regression (another tail branch beyond [[insurance-conformal]] prediction intervals); the 23rd member of the burning-cost family.
e.body_hk: insurance-quantile（burning-cost，PyPI v0.5.0）做保險定價的尾部風險分位數/expectile 迴歸：TVaR 相關風險量、大額損失加載、ILF（增額損失因子）曲線、EQRN 極端分位神經網絡（Pasche & Engelke）——英國個人險定價場景。對 RIAA：尾部定價的專門工具——與 [[insurance-severity]]（嚴重度建模）配套：severity 管分佈、quantile 管尾部迴歸；ILF 曲線是再保險與超額定價的核心（[[reinsurance]] 視角）；EQRN 是極值分位迴歸的前沿（[[insurance-conformal]] 預測區間之外的另一尾部分支）；burning-cost 家族第 23 個成員。
